why_relevant: Kosovo job portal with a company-directory structure (/companies/<id>/detajet), which is unusually useful: it gives a per-employer landing page and therefore a stable per-bank vacancy history URL. Also indexes public institutions (e.g. APRK), useful for regulator-side hiring.

Gjirafa is the dominant Albanian-language search/portal group in Kosovo; its jobs vertical aggregates vacancies across Kosovo and Albania. High crawl reach and good for catching ads posted only on employer sites that Gjirafa's crawler picked up.
Kosovo board self-describing as 'Njoftime Pune - Vende te lira pune - Vende vakante'. Adds the term 'vende vakante' to the glossary, which some employers use exclusively. Low-cost redundancy source.
Additional sq-language Kosovo jobs portal; associated in search results with Telegrafi's 'gjej pune shpejt' jobs push. Tail-coverage board.

Posts each konkurs with a timestamp and a deep link back to the job page. That timestamp is often the only reliable publication date once the underlying ad expires, and the feed is a low-cost change-detector that avoids crawling the board itself. Observed posting ProCredit Bank vacancies including Mitrovica e Veriut.

Critical workaround for portalpune.com's 403: the page publishes each bank konkurs with the direct portalpune.com/jobs/<id> link and a deadline ('Mbyllet Sot'), giving both the ID index and the closing date without hitting the defended site.

Kosovo's public-sector HR management information system publishing state vacancies. Relevant to this cell as the channel for regulator/state-financial-body hiring (ministry of finance, treasury, state-owned entities) - i.e. the public-sector mirror of bank org change. Not where commercial banks advertise.

Serbian-language coverage of the northern Kosovo labour market, which sq-language boards under-serve. Relevant for Serbian-system banking/PSP presence and for tracking staffing in the north (an area of structural change in Kosovo payments). Provides the sr glossary anchor 'oglasi za posao' / 'konkurs za posao'.

IT-weighted Serbian job board with a Kosovska Mitrovica location page. Useful specifically for detecting core-banking / payment-systems engineering hiring on the Serbian-language side, which is where technology-stack change shows up first.

Third sr-language board with a city-scoped feed for Kosovska Mitrovica. Included for redundancy in a language dimension where single-source risk is high (few sr boards actually carry Kosovo listings).
Fourth sr-language board indexing Kosovska Mitrovica vacancies. Tail source; keeps the sr dimension from depending on Infostud alone.

Employer-side page documenting posting products/packages. Reading it reveals how ads are structured, what metadata employers supply (deadline, city, category, industry taxonomy), and therefore what fields a collector can rely on. Also indicates which banks buy premium placement, a weak signal of hiring intensity.
Maintained directory of Kosovo job portals. Cheap periodic check for boards that appear or die - useful because this segment churns and a dead board silently creates a coverage hole.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosova — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Largest-tier Kosovo bank (~9.8k followers); posts management appointments, org announcements and campaign/product team news that precede press releases.

source_name: Career @ Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — LinkedIn careers showcase page
why_relevant: Dedicated recruiting page posting vacancies in Albanian ('Bëhuni pjesë e bankës më të mirë në Kosovë'); vacancy mix is the cleanest early read on which functions (cards, digital, compliance) are being built out.

source_name: NLB Banka Prishtina (NLB Prishtina sh.a) — LinkedIn company pages
why_relevant: NLB Kosovo posts appointments and org news; note TWO page variants exist (nlb-prishtina-sh.a and nlb-kos) — both must be tracked to avoid missing announcements.

source_name: TEB Sh.A. (TEB Bank Kosovo) — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: BNP Paribas-affiliated Kosovo bank (~5.5k followers); active in cards/POS acquiring — its role-change and hiring posts are directly on-topic for payments org change.
Kosovo arm of Banka Kombëtare Tregtare; separate page from the Albanian parent, so Kosovo-specific appointments and hiring surface here rather than on the group page.

source_name: FIKS — Fintech Kosovo cluster (LinkedIn signal via Kosovo Investment and Finance Network / KIFN)
why_relevant: Launch post names the fintech cluster's founding members (Numarics, OneFor, Paysera, Swinto) — a ready-made actor list of Kosovo payments/fintech employers whose LinkedIn pages and hiring posts should each be tracked.

Kosovar consumer-payments processor (founded 2014, Prishtina; top-ups, bill pay, parcel collection). Small enough that any hiring or leadership post is materially informative about the domestic payments-acceptance segment.

source_name: Quipu GmbH processing-centre staff profiles (ProCredit group IT/processing arm) on LinkedIn
why_relevant: Quipu is the ProCredit group's IT/card-processing arm and staffs Kosovo-linked processing roles; individual profiles of processing-centre leadership reveal card/switch platform responsibilities and moves that never appear in bank press releases.

Aggregated live vacancy feed for Prishtina (~200+ open roles observed); filtering by financial-services employers gives a continuous, comparable measure of banking/payments hiring intensity and of which functions are expanding.

source_name: Talent Network Kosova — LinkedIn page + own site (recruiter/executive search)
why_relevant: Licensed Prishtina headhunter (founded 2018 by Blerim Zogaj) doing C-level and board recruiting with stated placements in banking and fintech. Recruiter posts are the earliest public trace of an unfilled or newly created executive seat, often before the employer is named.

source_name: ERC International Recruitment & Executive Search — Kosovo (LinkedIn showcase)
why_relevant: Second executive-search actor with a Kosovo-specific showcase page; mandate posts corroborate or add to Talent Network signals on senior banking seats being opened.

source_name: InHunt World — Kosovo headhunting partner page
why_relevant: Open-web (non-LinkedIn) directory of the local executive-search partner for Kosovo — useful as a scrapeable proxy for the recruiter layer that is otherwise trapped behind LinkedIn's auth wall.

source_name: NLB Komercijalna banka — LinkedIn (rs) page, covering Serbian-language North Kosovo operations
why_relevant: Serbian-language banking presence serving the Serb-majority north (Kosovska Mitrovica); staffing and management posts here are the only professional-network trace of that parallel banking layer, which Albanian-language sources do not cover.
Secondary Serbian-language local job listing site for Mitrovica; redundancy for a thinly-sourced geography.
